messages.content: 什麼是具有多個細胞核的細胞類型的名稱？

function.name: bloodcell_classification
function.description: Identify and categorize different types of blood cells based on given attributes. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

cell_shape.description: The shape of the cell, e.g. round, oval.

cell_size.description: The size of the cell, e.g. large, medium, small.

message.content:
具有多個細胞核的細胞稱為「多核細胞」或「同步體（syncytium）」。在生物學中，這些細胞通常由兩個或更多個細胞融合而成，形成一個單一的大細胞質，其中包含多個獨立的細胞核。常見例子包括：

| 細胞類型 | 典型功能 | 為何會多核 |
|----------|----------|------------|
| 骨骼肌纖維 | 收縮運動 | 在發育過程中，許多前驅細胞融合成長大，以便一次性產生足夠的收縮力 |
| 肝臟肝細胞 | 代謝、解毒 | 某些肝細胞可在特定條件下融合以增強功能 |
| 巨噬細胞/巨噬細胞團 | 吞噬病原體 | 多核化有助於吞噬更大的目標 |

**關鍵詞：** 多核細胞 (polynuclear cell)、同步體 (syncytium)。
message.reasoning: The user asks in Chinese: "什麼是具有多個細胞核的細胞類型的名稱？" Means "What is the name of the type of cell with multiple nuclei?" They want the term for multinucleated cells. In biology, such cells are called syncytia or polynuclear cells. For example, skeletal muscle fibers are multinucleated. So answer: "多核细胞" or "syncytium". Provide explanation. No function call needed.
